# FG-SYS-0009

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 500 |
| 重大度 | alert |
| Runbook | [`backup-restore`](../../ops/runbooks/backup-restore.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `a_database_behind_the_repositories_is_detected` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: 復元の検証に失敗しました。問い合わせ番号を添えて管理者に連絡してください。
- en: The restore could not be verified. Contact the administrator with the request ID.
- id: Pemulihan tidak dapat diverifikasi. Hubungi administrator dengan menyertakan ID permintaan.

## 原因 (cause)

`forge restore verify` / `forge restore finish` (M3 O1, runbook backup-restore) found the restored database and repositories inconsistent, or a restore step could not run. Findings (`findings` = the kinds found, a count per kind in `<kind>`): `repository_missing` (a ready repository row has no directory), `repository_corrupt` (`git fsck --connectivity-only` failed: FG-GIT-0019 is logged with it), `version_ref_missing` / `version_ref_mismatch` (a `merge_request_versions` row names a commit that `refs/merge-requests/<iid>/v<n>` does not hold: the repositories are older than the database), `purged_ref_present` (a version whose refs the database says were purged — secret removal — still has its ref), and the database-behind findings `version_ref_unknown` (a version ref without its row) and `repository_unknown` (a repository directory without a row): the database is older than the repositories (a database-only restore). Other `reason`s: `restore_pending` (`forge serve` / `forge worker` refuse to start while `<storage.root>/.forge-restore-pending` exists: a restore was begun and not finished), `not_in_restore` (`forge restore repositories` / `finish` without `forge restore begin`), `generation_missing` (no complete generation of that name), `archive_corrupt` (decryption or the archive's structure failed: a wrong key, a truncated or altered file), `target_exists` (`forge restore repositories` found a repository directory and `--replace` was not given). Without a usable state copy `finish` does not fail: it removes every administrator flag and lists the users.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

Filter logs by error_code=FG-SYS-0009: `reason` or `findings`, the per-kind counts and `first` (the first finding: kind, `repo_id`, ref). Re-run `forge restore verify` (read-only) for the full list. Compare the restored generation's manifest.json `db.completed_at` with the pgBackRest backup label that was restored (`pgbackrest info`).

## 対処 (fix)

Follow runbook backup-restore. Repositories older than the database: restore the repositories of the same generation (`forge restore repositories --generation <g> --replace`). Database older than the repositories: decide with the runbook's table — `forge restore finish --accept-db-behind` keeps the newer repositories and lists what the database does not know. A corrupt repository: restore it from an older generation or follow repo-maintenance. Never delete the marker by hand to start forge serve: `forge restore finish` revokes every credential and re-applies the removed permissions first.
